title: Canonical structured evidence for Hostinger guards

phases.objective: Route Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard through the already registered trusted CI Evidence PR Publisher without granting repository/runtime mutation authority or creating a competing comment surface.

e2e_journeys.actor: repository reviewer and trusted workflow_run publisher
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A completed Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard run carrying a canonical structured artifact
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The trusted main-based CI Evidence PR Publisher validates the exact PR head, workflow and guard identity, contract, counts, no-secret declaration, and no-log decision before updating the shared authoritative PR comment.
steps: Receive the completed Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard workflow_run event through CI Evidence PR Publisher.
Checkout trusted main without persisted credentials.
Download only the run-bound hostinger-storage-tenant-canary summary artifact.
Validate workflow and guard identity, contract, candidate kind, exact candidate SHA, check counts, result count, first failure, secrets declaration, and job_logs_consulted=false.
Resolve exactly one open or merged PR from event PR number or exact repository, branch, and head SHA.
Reject stale, substituted, ambiguous, or closed-unmerged PR identities.
Add or replace only the Hostinger Tenant Canary section inside the existing mad4b canonical evidence comment.
assertions: The source and report workflow is Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard and guard_key is hostinger-storage-tenant-canary.
The sole publisher workflow is CI Evidence PR Publisher.
The candidate kind is head and candidate SHA equals workflow_run.head_sha.
Passed evidence requires all selected checks to pass, zero integrity findings, and first_failure=null.
Failed evidence identifies the first failed check and cannot be published by a successful workflow conclusion.
The report declares secrets_included=false and job_logs_consulted=false.
The publisher runs from trusted main with actions:read, issues:write, pull-requests:write, contents:read, and persist-credentials:false.
No specialized Hostinger publisher remains registered.
The PR-head Tenant Canary Guard receives no comment-write authority.
No deployment, provider call, credential access, migration, SQL, external send, Production mutation, protected-branch mutation, or force push occurs.

phases.objective: After merge, consume a real run-bound Tenant Canary artifact through CI Evidence PR Publisher and update the exact-head authoritative PR comment.
blockers: Independent specialized workflow_run publishers did not publish after runs 30728203790, 30728283325, and 30728916788, while CI Evidence PR Publisher consistently updated E2E evidence on the same PRs.
A post-merge Tenant Canary run must prove CI Evidence PR Publisher adds the Hostinger section for the same exact head.

phases.objective: Exercise artifact absence, malformed JSON, stale SHA, workflow identity mismatch, conflicting counts, ambiguous PR resolution, cancelled workflow runs, and publisher retries while keeping Job logs diagnostic-only.
Extend the same bounded contract to Shared Canary and Production Preflight only after Tenant Canary publication is proven end to end.
This repository evidence publisher grants no runtime, Hostinger, deployment, migration, or Production authority.
